sources.versions: Local atomic encrypted file; remote exact S3 key versions plus delete markers
sources.keyCustody: Random per-envelope DEK is wrapped in the envelope with the shared configured KEK; all object versions/envelopes must be removed before metadata acknowledgement. Shared KEK remains for counterparts.

sources.fence: Pending-upload reservation and row lock through write/activation; pending-delete row retained on storage failure, retry cleanup; prior real local-adapter proof retained

sources.disposition: No create-video producer in either scoped client per accepted N01; no hypothetical worker added or video/deployed-volume absence asserted
ZFS adapter reports actual capability and creates no snapshot during a write; operator-created snapshots/backups and deployed replication are not proven absent by the local fixture

limits: No physical disk-block wipe or forensic/backup crypto-erasure claim
No shared KEK destruction; deleting it would harm counterparts
No external S3 provider qualification or whole-account job wiring
